snippet.title: You Are NOT Bunnygirl Trailer 2
snippet.description:
You Are NOT Bunnygirl is an RPG about self-care and robots!

Manage Physical and Emotional Health as you guide Bunnygirl(?) through a dangerous, underground lab filled with malfunctioning machines.

If you'd like to support the game's development, please Wishlist and play the Demo on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1848490/You_Are_NOT_Bunnygirl/

You can also follow us on Twitter:
https://twitter.com/bunnygirlrpg
